qualification: Isolated checked replacement assembly plus borrowing already-coerced numbered captures. Pending Node, Wasm, parser and other VM changes excluded.

representation.authority: Canonical UTF-16 string storage; a transient slice plan derives the replacement result.
representation.length_policy: 536870888 UTF-16 units, matching existing legacy policy and local Node buffer.constants.MAX_STRING_LENGTH; checked arithmetic before retaining new output parts.
representation.failure_transition: Length/reservation failure clears retained output slices and stays failed. Replacement callbacks, named getters and coercions still run before finish returns RangeError.
representation.capture_projection: Numbered captures are strings or undefined after RegExp result coercion; substitution borrows the existing string rather than re-coercing and cloning its host view.
representation.lifecycle: Plan slices own Rc references, survive guest callback collection, and materialize only a valid result. No persistent rope or side map.
